claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The claimed full 5x5 matching-set transform is not a corollary of the known transform on only perfect permutations: Walsh transform is additive over the six cardinality layers, and the lower-layer contributions can create new zeros. The endpoint projection norm depends nonlinearly on the complete zero set, so it requires distinct verification.
